title: HaulBase
description: Fields shared by Haul and HaulSummary.

title.description: Short title for the whole set of recipes. Set once the AI response has been added.

language.description: BCP 47 tag for all free text in the recipes, e.g. sv-SE. Set once the AI response has been added.

generated_by.description: The assistant that generated the recipes. Set once the AI response has been added.

adults.description: Number of adults in the household.

children.description: Number of children in the household.

servings_per_meal.description: Servings per meal, including any extra portions for leftovers.

protein_preferences.description: Proteins the household eats. Proteins not listed are excluded from recipes.

cuisine_preferences.description: Preferred cuisines. An empty list means any cuisine.

updated_at.description: When the haul was last updated.
